```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row),
             key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Mark short gaps between same-color cells on a straight line.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((0, 1), (1, 0)):
                r1, c1 = r - dr, c - dc
                r2, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
                while 0 <= r1 < h and 0 <= c1 < w and grid[r1][c1] == bg:
                    r1 -= dr
                    c1 -= dc
                while 0 <= r2 < h and 0 <= c2 < w and grid[r2][c2] == bg:
                    r2 += dr
                    c2 += dc
                if (0 <= r1 < h and 0 <= c1 < w and
                    0 <= r2 < h and 0 <= c2 < w and
                    grid[r1][c1] == grid[r2][c2] and
                    abs(r2-r1) + abs(c2-c1) <= 4):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
```
